name: WPA PROTOCOLometry COMMAND CENTER
purpose: One governed supervisory layer connecting WPA public-source intelligence, rights/provenance, WPA-native transformation, Protocolometry, research/product pipelines, Virtual/Viral Sande, distribution, membership, partnerships, monetization and Human Authority.

state_vocabulary.IMPLEMENTED: Executable or generated system component exists and has machine-readable evidence.
state_vocabulary.IMPLEMENTED_HUMAN_GATED: Automation may prepare or measure, but consequential application requires Human Authority.
state_vocabulary.DESIGN_READY_ACTIVATION_INACTIVE: Architecture exists but an authoritative backend, authorised connector, contract, payment service or registry is not active.
state_vocabulary.DEGRADED: The system continues safely with partial source/service availability and no rights relaxation.
state_vocabulary.BLOCKED: A rights, provenance, security, originality, authority or release gate prevents downstream use.

separation_rules: Open visibility is not reuse permission.
A card visual is not membership status.
Paid membership does not confer academic merit or institutional authority.
A social or messenger draft is not an authorised publication.
A partner candidate is not a partnership.
Revenue readiness is not payment activation.
